name: Clay
description: Clay is a go-to-market data and workflow platform for finding people and companies, enrichment, research, scoring, routing, tables, integrations, and outbound operations.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned Clay Public API key to validate one exact user/workspace binding and read only opaque workspace/user identifiers plus workspace name. Relay pins GET https://api.clay.com/public/v0/me, the clay-api-key header, response size, returned fields, audit, redaction, and approval boundary while excluding personal identity, GTM records, Searches, Routines, Claygents, Workflows, Enterprise table queries, credit-consuming actions, MCP/CLI, mutations, pagination, uploads, webhooks, and exports.

capabilities.label: Read connected workspace
capabilities.description: Validate the exact API-key-bound Clay workspace and return only opaque workspace/user identifiers and workspace name.

approvalRequired.label: Read connected workspace
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded workspace and opaque user identifiers for the exact Clay Public API key without returning personal identity or GTM data.

blocked.label: Search or enrich GTM data
blocked.description: Searches, filter discovery, routines, Clay-managed or custom functions, Claygents, Workflows, enrichment, scoring, routing, and credit-consuming runs are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private table data
blocked.description: Enterprise table queries, rows, cells, fields, people, companies, contact details, firmographics, signals, and other workspace content are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Clay data
blocked.description: Creating or changing tables, workflows, functions, searches, runs, records, integrations, settings, or other Clay state is outside V1.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary Clay tools
blocked.description: The raw Public API, MCP server, CLI, plugin, arbitrary origins, paths, methods, parameters, filters, cursors, payloads, and alpha surfaces are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export Clay data
blocked.description: Batch runs, uploads, webhooks, polling, automatic pagination, crawling, synchronization, downloads, and exports are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded private workspace-binding read requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected workspace-binding read runs without Relay per-action approval while exact key authority, fixed origin and endpoint, audit, redaction, response bounds, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one bounded approval-gated Clay workspace-binding read and keeps the API key encrypted on Railway.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Clay account, Public API key, or live acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create a dedicated Clay Public API key under the beta API-key settings, store it through Relay, then validate exact workspace binding, the bounded workspace read, Safe approval, Dangerous read, permission denial, key rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial without running credit-consuming or private-data APIs.

evidence.supports: Clay documents the fixed https://api.clay.com/public/v0 origin, personal API keys, the required clay-api-key header, user/workspace binding, server-side storage, and the GET /me example.
Clay documents the open-beta developer platform and its Searches, Routines, read-only Enterprise Tables, API, CLI, and MCP primitives.

Clay documents Enterprise-only table reads, required known table IDs, structured field/filter queries, maximum page size 100, and cursor pagination; Relay excludes this private, customer-schema-dependent surface from V1.
Clay documents per-workspace rate limiting, HTTP 429, Retry-After, and optional X-RateLimit headers.
